jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)
jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE COMPANY**

carloans 365 is a fast\-growing, industry\-leading car finance broker based in Sale, just 10 minutes from Manchester City Centre.

Our mission is simple: to empower our customers by securing the best finance deals tailored to their needs, helping them drive away in their perfect car. With rapid growth and a reputation for delivering exceptional customer service, we pride ourselves on making car finance quick, easy and hassle\-free. Join us at carloans 365, where customer satisfaction drives our success.

**ENOUGH ABOUT US, WHAT'S THE ROLE?**

Technology is central to the next stage of our growth. We're building and improving bespoke internal platforms, customer and operational tools, CRM and telephony integrations, automation, AI\-enabled services and data solutions that support teams across the business.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) who can take genuine ownership of software from idea to production. You'll work closely with our Head of Technical Operations and senior stakeholders to understand what the business needs, turn those requirements into well\-designed technical solutions, and then build, test, deploy and continuously improve them. This is a hands\-on role for someone equally comfortable creating intuitive front\-end experiences and building the back\-end services, databases, APIs and integrations behind them.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Designing, building and owning bespoke web applications, internal platforms, tools and services from initial requirement and technical design through to production deployment and ongoing improvement
* Building responsive, accessible and intuitive front\-end applications using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript practices
* Designing and developing robust back\-end services, business logic and APIs using modern server\-side technologies such as Node.js/TypeScript, C\#/.NET, Python or equivalent
* Designing, querying and optimising relational databases, including SQL data models and reliable data flows between systems
* Creating secure integrations between internal applications and third\-party platforms including CRM, telephony, AI services, lenders, reporting tools and other business systems
* Working directly with operational teams and senior stakeholders to understand problems, challenge requirements where appropriate and translate them into practical technical solutions
* Owning the full software development lifecycle including scoping, architecture, development, code review, testing, deployment, monitoring, support and iteration
* Building reusable components, services and integration patterns that provide a scalable technical foundation for future growth
* Building security, privacy and auditability into applications from the outset, including authentication, role\-based access, logging and secure handling of customer and commercially sensitive data
* Mentoring less experienced developers or technical team members and helping establish strong engineering practices across the team

**SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE**

**Essential Technical Skills**

* Strong commercial full\-stack software engineering experience, with evidence of personally delivering production software across both front\-end and back\-end development
* Strong React experience together with modern JavaScript and/or TypeScript, HTML and CSS
* Strong back\-end development experience with a modern technology such as Node.js/TypeScript, C\#/.NET, Python or equivalent
* Strong SQL and relational database experience, including schema design, querying, performance considerations and data integrity
* Experience designing, building and consuming REST APIs and integrating multiple third\-party systems
* Experience taking software from requirements through architecture, build, automated testing, deployment and ongoing production support
* Strong Git/version\-control practices, including branching, pull requests and code review, together with experience of automated testing
* Experience deploying and operating applications in a cloud environment such as Azure, AWS or equivalent, including CI/CD, monitoring and secure software development practices

**Working Style \& Mindset**

* Ownership mindset: comfortable being responsible for a solution end to end rather than only one layer of the stack
* Commercially minded: able to understand the operational problem behind a request and build the solution that creates the most value
* Pragmatic problem\-solver: able to move quickly without sacrificing security, reliability or maintainability
* Confident communicator: able to explain technical decisions, risks and trade\-offs clearly to non\-technical stakeholders
* Self\-directed and proactive: comfortable working in a growing technical function where not every requirement will arrive perfectly defined
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, FCA\-regulated environment where data quality, customer outcomes, controls and auditability matter

**Desirable (but not required)**

* Experience building software within financial services, fintech, motor finance, insurance or another regulated environment
* Experience with contact\-centre or telephony platforms such as ConnexAI, Twilio, Five9 or similar
* Experience with Azure/AWS, CI/CD, Docker or modern application hosting patterns
* Practical experience integrating AI/LLM services, CRM platforms, real\-time systems, queues, webhooks or event\-driven architecture

**WHAT THE ROLE ISN’T**

This isn't a front\-end\-only, back\-end\-only or systems\-administration role. We need someone who can understand a business problem and build the complete solution around it. You'll be expected to work across the application, database, API and integration layers, take responsibility for what happens after deployment, ask the right questions and help us decide the best way to build solutions around how carloans 365 actually operates.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Genuine ownership of products and systems that have a direct impact on how the business operates
* Opportunity to build bespoke technology rather than simply maintain legacy or off\-the\-shelf systems
* Direct exposure to senior decision\-making and the ability to influence technical direction and architecture
* A varied engineering environment spanning customer journeys, internal operations, CRM, telephony, AI, automation and data
* Opportunity to help establish engineering standards and shape the technical team as the business continues to grow

**DETAILS**

* £70,000 \- £80,000 per annum (DOE)
* Working pattern: 09:00 – 18:00, 5 days per week, Monday – Friday
* 28 days holiday (bank holidays are normal working days) \+ 1 additional day off for your birthday

**ADDITIONAL BENEFITS**

* Bupa Private Medical Insurance: access to private healthcare through our company Bupa scheme
* Employee Car Scheme: access to our exclusive employee car scheme
* Employee Assistance Programme (EAP): confidential support and guidance when you need it
* Company Events

Pay: £70,000\.00\-£80,000\.00 per year

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Sale M33 7RR: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (required)

Work authorisation:

* United Kingdom (required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.**


At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.


There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**  

Are you a highly motivated multi\-disciplinary engineer looking to work on building projects that can change the world, projects that are always more complex and innovative than the last?


We are looking for an experienced Senior Engineer to join our MEP team. This is a hybrid role and you could be based in our London, Croydon, St.Albans, Manchester, Leeds, Exeter, Cardiff or Bristol office to work across a broad range of sectors and for a broad range of clients. You will be joining a team of like\-minded experts that have a passion for innovation and delivering cutting edge solutions.

 **About Us:**

AECOM plays a critical role in the conceptualisation and creation of amazing spaces, delivering projects and buildings that define skylines and communities. AECOM Buildings \& Places – Design is made up of dedicated teams delivering projects in Commercial, Residential, Hospitality, Sports Venues, Work Places, Data Centres, Education, Government, Healthcare and Defence.


We are friendly, busy and motivated with an established track record of successfully delivering local and overseas projects. Some of our flagship work in recent years include:

* **Healthcare**: AECOM is a leading award\-winning consultant for the NHS in the UK and internationally, delivering projects ranging from major acute hospitals to primary care and estate refurbishment schemes, while supporting the NHS Net Zero Carbon agenda.
* **Decarbonisation**: Multiple projects where we have undertaken the feasibility of the removal of boilers and installation of Air Source and Water source heat pumps to provide the heating and cooling for the building. Projects include commercial buildings like 80 – 100 Victoria Street London, British Library, multiple residential buildings in the Royal Borough of Greenwich and even Windsor Castle.
* **Stratford Cross**: A major mixed\-use regeneration development in Stratford, East London, located within the former Olympic Park area. Our team are providing multi\-discipline services including MEP, civil \& structural, vertical transportation, energy \& sustainability, acoustics, air quality, ecology, transport, waste management, and façade engineering.
* **Data Centres**: Working for multiple major hyperscale projects in the Nordics, Iberia and South America. These projects provide the opportunity to tackle the issue of data management and storage specific to each country. Designing and implementing a highly resilient electrical infrastructure entails the usage of an efficient system that is highly sustainable.
* **Lansdowne House**: High\-end commercial office development occupying the South\-East side of Berkley Square, Mayfair, City of Westminster, with an all\- electric energy centre containing Ground Source Heat Pumps, Air Source Heat Pumps and High Efficiency Chillers.
* **10 Dock:** Western Europe’s largest naval dockyard in Plymouth, a defence project of enormous scale and multiple components that must come together as a solution to meet a new capability.

 **About Our Team:**


Our award\-winning and close\-knit Building Services team have a strong presence across sectors and we have and a strong Public Health engineering team throughout the UK. The team is seeking to expand their capabilities further by adding a Senior Public Health Engineer with experience in delivering sustainable projects across multiple sectors, has excellent team working and co\-ordination skills and strives for technical excellence.


You will be an integral part of the diverse and dynamic national AECOM PH team which will support your technical career development. Challenges such as the net zero agenda and water neutrality provide great opportunities for your career to flourish with the role also including Fire Protection systems design which will be supported by our experienced specialist fire protection engineering team to provide the opportunity to develop new design skills. The position is predominantly office located role to ensure face\-to\-face contact time with the team.


The Senior Engineer will be responsible for leading much of the Public Health and Fire Protection systems design on projects and involve client liaison, mentoring and leading the discipline/systems to prepare scheme and detailed engineering designs. The successful candidate will have proven design experience, delivering to quality, time and budget. This role will suit someone with who is enthusiastic, self\-motivated, and looking to advance their career.

  

The role will include taking point lead on multiple PH systems design/calculations on a project as well as assisting the lead PH engineer with experience in the following systems:

* Hot and cold water systems
* Above ground foul and rainwater system
* Fire Protection Systems
* Below Ground drainage systems
* Pumped drainage systems
* Water and oil leak detection systems
* Rainwater harvesting and Greywater recycling systems
* Water conservation solutions
* BREEAM, LEED and Ska Rating design integration


Duties of the role will include, but not be limited to;

* Maintaining Client relationships
* Mentoring and developing staff
* Project Managing small sized multi\-disciplinary projects
* Obtain the necessary information both internally and externally from Architects, Quantity Surveyors and Design Consultants to provide a fully coordinated design
* Ensure the Design Team is kept fully informed of all technical and other information necessary for the duration of the project
* Be familiar with the BIM design process and be capable of input and support for projects designed in Revit
* Ensure compliance with all Statutory and Regulatory obligations, make submissions to the Statutory Authorities and obtain approvals as necessary
* Produce all design information and ensure that all calculations are prepared and signed off in accordance with the requirements of the QA procedures, relevant Standards and Codes of Practice
* Represent AECOM at Client, Design Team and Progress meetings throughout the design and construction phases of projects
* Support AECOM PM with input to pre\-qualification and selection of contractors, also respond to tender queries, comment and review tender returns
* Ensure the project work complies with the Project Management Plan and Programme
* Understand and implement AECOM’s Safety Health and Environment Policy

**Minimum Requirements:**

* Previous public health engineering work experience within design consultancy or other relevant business
* A comprehensive working knowledge of statutory regulations to ensure design compliance, make submissions to the statutory authorities and obtaining approvals as necessary
* Be able to work independently and have good time/task management skills
* Experience in mixed used, residential, commercial and healthcare buildings/sectors
* Fully competent in the use of AutoCad to produce 2D drawings
* Fully competence in using 3D Revit software and Navisworks reviewing software
* Ability to speak fluently and communicate effectively in written reports and oral presentations

 **Qualifications**  

* Chartered Engineer with CIBSE / IET / IMechE (or working towards)
* BEng for a relevant engineering course (MEng preferred)
* CIBSE SoPHE Member

  

**Additional Information**  

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

 **About AECOM**


AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public\- and private\-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.

**Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity**


You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.


You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.


AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well\-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.


Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry\-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours.


We are a Disability Confident Employer and will offer an interview to applicants who have a disability or long\-term condition, who meet the minimum/essential criteria for the role. Please let us know using this email address ReasonableAccommodationsUKI@aecom.com if you would like to apply through the Disability Confident Interview Scheme.


All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

* Above ground foul and rainwater system
* Fire Protection Systems
* Below Ground drainage systems
* Pumped drainage systems
* Water and oil leak detection systems
* Rainwater harvesting and Greywater recycling systems
* Water conservation solutions
* BREEAM, LEED and Ska Rating design integration

* Mentoring and developing staff

* Obtain the necessary information both internally and externally from Architects, Quantity Surveyors and Design Consultants to provide a fully coordinated design
* Ensure the Design Team is kept fully informed of all technical and other information necessary for the duration of the project
* Be familiar with the BIM design process and be capable of input and support for projects designed in Revit
* Ensure compliance with all Statutory and Regulatory obligations, make submissions to the Statutory Authorities and obtain approvals as necessary
* Produce all design information and ensure that all calculations are prepared and signed off in accordance with the requirements of the QA procedures, relevant Standards and Codes of Practice

jobs.description:
The E.ON I\&C Pillar combines the current npower Business Solutions \& E.ON B2B businesses to create a new £5billion revenue business serving c60,000 customers and around 300,000 meter points with a view to becoming the number one B2B energy supplier in the UK. The Digital Technology \& Change organisation is the integration consisting of Change Management, Digital Data and Technology \& Partner and Service Management functions to provide Change \& IT services to the E.ON I\&C business. The Senior Software Engineer is a key member of the nBS Digital Solutions team and is responsible for leading the build, optimisation and support of effective digital solutions, software and applications . The role holder is required to provide expert consultancy on the solution design, specification, development, build, functional and user testing, deployment, migration and warranty provision of nBS owned and managed digital solutions. The role\-holder will have an in\-depth and highly specialised knowledge of the nBS Digital Solutions application portfolio, associated business processes and data contained within the systems. The role holder is required to demonstrate the highest levels of creativity in solution design and delivery, keeping abreast of the latest system and industry developments, design and coding trends and has persistence to deliver beyond expectation.
* Responsible for developing new digital solutions to satisfy business requirements within the nBS product backlog to drive delivery of project benefit to nBS. A chief practitioner in application development for nBS.
* Responsible for delivering first class support and maintenance of delivered solutions, ensuring solution performance always meets expectations, application stability and delivering solutions to meet defects or changes within agreed SLAs
* Responsible for supporting E2E delivery of change projects using own knowledge and expertise within the project.
* Working in partnership with third party developers and EON Digital Technologies to optimize solution delivery for nBS.
* Responsible for environment management and maintenance, including any hosting, integration, access and security considerations.
* Responsible for self\-learning and development on solution development platforms, practices and techniques
* Acting passionately as an advocate for innovation, continually challenges traditional thinking.
* Driving insight and value add from interpretation of customer or user behaviour through detailed usage analytics.
* Responsible for communicating \& interacting effectively with internal or external colleagues and management to explain complex system issues clearly and concisely.
* Providing trusted technical expertise and specialised knowledge of the nBS Digital Solutions portfolio to impact\-assess proposed changes or technological opportunities.
* Ensuring that all developments, enhancements and support fixes adhere to the DD\&C governance model.
* Responsible for mentoring the developer team. Supporting them with technical expertise, escalating issues and blockers effectively and professionally.


* Proven experience building successful, low\-maintenance enterprise applications and digital solutions.
* Strong software design and programming skills (Javascript, HTML, XML, SQL, Apex, SOAP, C\#, VB.net) and experience with Microsoft .NET and Visual Studio.
* Experience in using AI tools such as Claude code to fast prototype solutions and mentor other developers in such technologies.
* Forward\-thinking and agile, able to manage multiple projects with flexible prioritisation, anticipating future changes to ensure scalability and opportunity.
* Proficient in data analysis, process optimisation, and working within change governance and project delivery methodologies (Waterfall \& Agile).
* Excellent communicator, able to translate technical information to non\-technical colleagues and bridge gaps between development teams and stakeholders.
* Sets and maintains high standards in bespoke and digital application development, with strong planning, organisation, self\-reliance, and attention to detail.
* Committed to coaching and guiding teams to ensure consistency across the development lifecycle.
* Curious, solution\-oriented, and driven to deliver “best in class” services while building innovative, opportunity\-rich stakeholder relationships.
* Embraces a culture of trust and empowerment, making autonomous or collaborative decisions to advance design, delivery, and assurance activities.
* Demonstrates empathy towards colleagues' concerns about automation and digitisation and delivers agile solutions aligned with stakeholder expectations, milestones, and quality standards to achieve the nBS digital strategy.


Join E.ON’s I\&C Pillar, a dynamic £5 billion business serving 60,000 customers and managing 300,000 meter points, with a bold ambition to become the UK’s leading B2B energy supplier. Within our Digital Technology \& Change organisation, you’ll be part of an integrated team delivering cutting\-edge Change \& IT services to power this growth.  

We’re seeking a Senior Software Engineer to lead the design, build, and optimisation of innovative digital solutions within the nBS Digital Solutions team. This role offers the opportunity to apply your expert knowledge across solution design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support of our digital portfolio.  

  

Bring your creativity, deep technical expertise, and passion for innovation to help shape the future of E.ON’s digital transformation and exceed expectations in delivering industry\-leading solutions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop new digital solutions to meet nBS product backlog requirements and drive project benefits as a lead application developer.
* Provide high\-quality support and maintenance, ensuring solution performance, stability, and timely resolution of defects or changes within SLAs.
* Support end\-to\-end delivery of change projects using expert knowledge.
* Collaborate with third\-party developers and E.ON Digital Technologies to optimise nBS solution delivery.
* Manage and maintain environments, including hosting, integration, access, and security.
* Continuously self\-learn and develop skills in solution platforms and techniques.
* Advocate for innovation and challenge traditional approaches.
* Drive value by analysing customer and user behaviour through detailed usage analytics.

**Turn technical insight into real\-world impact. Help leading brands understand their energy use, reduce waste and make their buildings perform better.**


At Best.Energy, we make buildings smarter, more efficient and more sustainable. Our energy monitoring and control technology gives organisations the insight they need to reduce costs and take meaningful action towards net zero.


We’re looking for a **Technical Sales Engineer** who combines technical understanding with commercial confidence. Someone who can understand a customer’s challenges, identify the right solution and build a compelling case for investment across multiple sites.

**The Details**


UK\-based, with hybrid working


£60,000\+ base salary with OTE of £120,000\+


Permanent, full\-time


Regular UK\-wide travel required for customer meetings and site visits

**About the Role**


You’ll help organisations turn complex energy challenges into practical, commercially sound solutions. Working with senior decision\-makers, technical teams and operational stakeholders, you’ll connect what our technology can do with the results that matter to each customer.


We’re particularly interested in experience within multi\-site hospitality and working with global brands, where solutions need to deliver value at individual locations and across an entire estate.


From initial discovery and site visits through to proposals, negotiations and contract signature, you’ll combine a consultative sales approach with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly. You’ll work closely with our technical and delivery teams to ensure proposals are achievable and customers experience a smooth handover.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and convert technical sales opportunities, managing the process from discovery through to contract signature
* Understand customers’ buildings, operational priorities and energy challenges through detailed conversations and site visits
* Build relationships with senior commercial, finance, sustainability, facilities and engineering stakeholders
* Deliver tailored demonstrations and presentations that make technical solutions clear and relevant
* Work with technical colleagues to define suitable solutions and develop accurate proposals
* Build credible business cases covering potential energy savings, costs and return on investment
* Support multi\-site opportunities, from initial pilots through to wider estate rollouts
* Negotiate commercial terms that deliver value for the customer and protect business margin
* Maintain accurate CRM records, pipeline forecasts and opportunity updates
* Coordinate clear handovers to delivery teams, capturing agreed scope and customer expectations
* Travel throughout the UK to support customer engagement and sales progression

**What We’re Looking For**


✅ Proven experience in technical or solution\-led sales, with a track record of securing high\-value or complex contracts


✅ The ability to understand technical products and translate their capabilities into clear commercial benefits


✅ Strong discovery, presentation and negotiation skills


✅ Confidence engaging with both technical specialists and senior decision\-makers


✅ Commercial awareness and the ability to build credible, evidence\-led investment cases


✅ Strong organisation, accurate CRM management and ownership of your sales pipeline


✅ A collaborative, self\-motivated and results\-focused approach


✅ Willingness and ability to travel throughout the UK

**It would be particularly useful if you bring:**

* Experience selling energy management, energy efficiency or related building technology solutions
* Experience working with multi\-site hospitality businesses, such as hotel, restaurant or leisure groups
* Experience managing relationships with global brands and navigating complex buying processes
* An understanding of how successful site\-level pilots develop into wider portfolio rollouts


Experience in another high\-value technical sales environment is equally welcome if you can demonstrate transferable skills and an aptitude for learning our solutions.

**Life at Best.Energy**


We’re a fast\-paced, mission\-driven team, and we’re committed to supporting our people. Our benefits include:


✨ NEST pension scheme


✨ 33 days’ flexible holiday allowance, increasing with length of service


✨ Everyday Healthcare cashback plan


✨ Dedicated learning time


✨ Two volunteer days each year


✨ Enhanced parental and family leave


✨ Regular company\-wide events and opportunities to collaborate


We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace. If you enjoy connecting technical solutions with commercial opportunities and want your work to contribute to a more sustainable future, we’d love to hear from you.


If you require any adjustments during the application process, please let us know.

Please visit http://Best.Energy for more information

**Build your engineering career in renewable energy**

Are you a Mechanical or Electrical Engineering graduate, or an early\-career engineer looking for your next opportunity?

Join Photon Energy, part of Project Better Energy, as an Estimating Engineer and put your technical and numerical skills to work on solar PV projects.

You’ll work closely with our sales and engineering colleagues to develop outline solar PV designs, calculate project costs and prepare customer proposals. You’ll help customers understand how their proposed system will perform, what it will cost and its expected return on investment.

As your experience grows, you’ll have the opportunity to work across Commercial New Build, Residential New Build and Commercial Retrofit projects.

**Your responsibilities**

* Understand customer requirements by working closely with the relevant sales colleague.
* Create outline solar PV designs, including design drawings and system performance simulations.
* Prepare accurate project estimates using our in\-house pricing tool.
* Produce clear customer proposals covering system design, price and expected return on investment.
* Attend customer meetings alongside sales and engineering colleagues when required.
* Represent the company professionally and promote its products and services.
* Follow company working practices, quality procedures, health and safety requirements, and relevant statutory and regulatory standards.

**What you’ll need**

* A Mechanical or Electrical Engineering degree, or an equivalent qualification.
* Confidence using AutoCAD and Microsoft Office.
* A basic understanding of renewable energy and enthusiasm for working in the sector.
* Strong numerical skills and close attention to detail when preparing designs and quotations.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to work well with customers and colleagues.
* Good organisation and time management, with the ability to prioritise tasks and meet deadlines.
* An appreciation of how accurate, efficient work contributes to customer satisfaction and commercial performance.

**This role is suitable for graduates and candidates with up to two years of relevant experience.**

**What’s in it for you?**

* Competitive salary.
* 37\.5\-hour working week, Monday to Friday.
* Flexible working once fully trained, with three days per week in the office.
* Reading as the preferred location, with Poole or Rochester also available.
* 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays.
* The opportunity to develop experience across a range of solar PV projects.

**About Project Better Energy**

At Project Better Energy, we’re on a mission to make renewable energy accessible to everyone. We are home to Project Solar UK, Project EV, Project CÜRV, EG Solar and Photon Energy. Together, we deliver high\-quality green technology products and services that support a net\-zero future.

**Senior Power System Engineer**
================================

  

National Grid is hiring a Senior Power System Engineer \- This position is based from our Warwick office however we offer flexible hybrid working options.


You will develop into a highly capable transmission planning engineer, building expertise in strategic network assessment, system modelling, and Net Zero network development while contributing to some of the most significant transmission investment decisions in Great Britain.


### **Job Purpose**


As a Senior Power System Engineer within the Net Zero Engineering team, you will lead the technical assessment of future electricity transmission network requirements to support the decarbonisation of Great Britain's energy system. You will play a key role in identifying network needs, assessing system capability, developing innovative solutions, and providing robust engineering evidence to inform major transmission investment decisions.


Working across National Grid Electricity Transmission, NESO, customers, regulators, and industry stakeholders, you will lead strategic studies that support long\-term network development, enabling the integration of renewable generation, large\-scale demand growth, electrification, and emerging technologies.


You will combine advanced power system engineering expertise, modelling, analytics, and strategic thinking to ensure the future network can deliver Net Zero outcomes safely, efficiently, and economically.


### **What You'll Do**


* Lead strategic network planning studies to identify future transmission system needs and reinforcement requirements.
* Lead boundary capability assessments and transfer capability studies to assess future network constraints and opportunities.
* Develop technical recommendations to support transmission investment decisions and business cases.
* Assess the impact of generation, storage, demand growth, data centres, hydrogen, electrification, and emerging technologies on transmission system capability.
* Develop, model and evaluate innovative network solutions, including topology optimisation, flexibility services, HVDC, FACTS, and other system\-wide interventions.
* Translate complex technical analysis into clear strategic recommendations for senior stakeholders.
* Lead development of modelling methodologies, analytical tools, and data\-driven approaches to network planning.
* Provide technical leadership for innovation projects relating to future network operation and Net Zero delivery.
* Build strong relationships across National Grid, NESO, Ofgem, customers, and wider industry organisations.
* Mentor and coach engineers, supporting capability development across the team.
* Champion engineering excellence, governance, and compliance with industry standards and licence obligations.
### **About You**


**Essential**


* Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Significant experience in transmission planning, strategic network planning, system studies, or power system analysis.
* Strong understanding of:
* Power system analysis and modelling.
* Transmission planning methodologies.
* Boundary capability and transfer assessments.
* Network investment appraisal and cost\-benefit assessment.
* Future energy scenarios and system planning processes.
* Strong working knowledge of:
	+ NETS SQSS
	+ Grid Code
	+ CUSC
	+ Relevant transmission planning standards
* Experience using power system analysis tools such as PowerFactory, PSS®E, PSCAD, or equivalent.
* Excellent problem\-solving and critical\-thinking skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to influence technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

**Desirable**


* Experience in tCSNP, ETYS, NOA, SSEP, CSNP, or similar network planning processes.
* Experience in Python, DPL, optimisation techniques, data analytics, or automation.
* Knowledge of probabilistic assessment techniques and Monte Carlo analysis.
* Understanding of HVDC, FACTS, power electronics\-dominated networks, and system operability challenges.
* Chartered Engineer status or working towards Chartered status.
### **What You'll Get**


A competitive salary dependent on capability


Plus Market Suppliemnt Annual £4,500


As well as your base salary, you will receive a bonus based on personal and company performance and a competitive contributory pension scheme where we will double match your contribution to a maximum company contribution of 12%. You will also have access to a number of flexible benefits such as a share incentive plan, salary sacrifice car and technology schemes, support via employee assistance lines and matched charity giving to name a few.

  

The closing date for this vacancy is 14th October. However, we encourage candidates to submit their applications as early as possible and not to wait until the published closing date. National Grid’s recruitment periods can and may vary. We reserve the right to remove this advert or close it to further applications at any point during the recruitment process.


In NGET we are passionate about both operating our network safely and providing highly reliable quality of supply for our customers. At the heart of achieving these outcomes is the effective control and operation of our network.


To find out more , please follow the link below:


https://www.nationalgrid.com/electricity\-transmission/

Onderzoek hoe wijzigingen aan datastructuren en -modellen binnen SQL Server(less) databases en Analysis Services-omgevingen in Azure Cloud zó uitgerold kunnen worden dat de beschikbaarheid van data behouden blijft. If you've already gained some hands-on experience in professional software development and are eager to grow into a skilled consultant in a low-hierarchy, supportive environment, we would love to hear from you. Let’s find your Road!

TLDR

Role: Software Developer (Associate Consultant or Consultant)
Focus: Help businesses grow by building and improving digital sales channels and systems for our clients.
Environment: Low-hierarchy, supportive, community-led, with an emphasis on transparency and trust.
Team: Varying teams built around each individual client’s need. Cross-competence collaboration.
Ideal Candidate: A couple years of professional web development (full-stack) experience, eager to learn and make an impact. The position is also suitable for someone finishing their studies. Fluent in English and Finnish.
Location: Helsinki or Tampere, no visa sponsorships offered.
Salary & benefits: Monthly gross salary 3000-4500€, depending on your experience and stage of potential studies. Extensive benefits package, including e.g. comprehensive healthcare insurance, allowance for sports/massage/commuting and compensation for doing social good & open source projects to name a few.

Who we are

Columbia Road is the go-to consulting partner for businesses that want to sell better. Excelling in both commercial operations and scalable technology, we build seamless and effective customer journeys for measurable impact. In each of our projects, we focus on generating more revenue and more customers for our clients, working in cross-competence teams made up of the brightest minds in digital commerce.

As a community-led company, we believe in giving a lot of responsibility and freedom to our employees. Instead of line managers and red tape, we offer the tools and resources to all Roadies to make the best possible decisions for their own job and for our community. We offer you a diverse and inclusive workplace, and your fellow Roadies will ensure that you’ll feel comfortable from day one.

The job & what you’d be working on

As a software developer, you are interested in what happens under the hood of modern digital sales channels. You’ll get to work together with other Columbia Road consultants in a cross-competence team, building and growing new digital businesses for our customers in various fields of business. This means you may collaborate daily with designers, digital marketers, strategy consultants, data & AI specialists as well as our clients' stakeholders and team. You will be supported in your learning by peers in both development and other domains, and you’ll have the ability to create real impact in our clients’ businesses.

Your motivation comes from the results and impact your solution creates, rather than the technical beauty of the code. For us, technology is a tool to create business impact for our clients, and we are agnostic in choosing whichever tools best solve the challenge. This can mean widely used programming languages and frameworks, but also different CRM, CMS and ecommerce solutions that we customise and integrate to our clients’ other systems. We have listed some examples further below.

If you're looking for a workplace where you get a lot of responsibility and where you get to learn new things fast from more experienced peers, you'll find it here. You will get to grow with us, nurture your own ambitions and learn new skills within digital sales.

This position is a great fit for you if

You are a student in the final year of your studies, or have graduated within the past couple of years.
You have already gained professional work experience related to software development. For example, you may have worked part time in a professional setting during your studies.
You have a good understanding of the basic principles of both backend and frontend software development.
You’re agnostic in your tech-approach and are open to using a wide array of languages, frameworks, CRM and CMS systems and ecommerce platforms, selecting the tools that best match our clients’ needs.
Some of the most common languages we come across in our work are JavaScript, Typescript, PHP, Java and C#. We hope you are comfortable with more than one of these.
Other technologies seen as an advantage include: Clojure, Scala, Python, Go as well as any experience working with CMS, CRM and ecommerce platforms.
You are self-driven, proactive and want to continuously learn new things.
You understand the basics of digitalisation and you approach problems in an analytical manner.
You would love to work with challenging client cases supported by a diverse community of digital sales professionals.
You are comfortable communicating matters related to your own work and you enjoy working with other people in an agile environment – it’s not a problem for you to present your own ideas to a small group of people from time to time, for example in a workshop.
You have a “get things done” attitude towards your work.
You live (or plan to move) within commuting distance of Helsinki or Tampere and are open to working on-site according to client needs.
You are fluent in English and Finnish.

Recruitment process

Our recruitment process typically involves 2-3 interviews where we learn about your skills and what motivates you. You'll discover more about Columbia Road and meet various Roadies along the way. After our discussions, we'll reach out to your chosen references.
This is a permanent, full-time position with a flexible start date from August 2026. We hope to hear from you soon!

Benefits

A monthly gross salary of 3000-4500 euros, depending on your experience and stage of potential studies. In addition, we offer extensive benefits:
A community-led organisation with a high level of autonomy
A diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace
Option to buy stocks of the company through the common employee share program
Recurring training and learning sessions to support your professional growth
Regular mentoring with a Roadie of your own choosing - or several!
Offices in downtown Helsinki (with gym and pool) and Tampere
A wide selection of quality tools to use for your work (laptop, phone etc.)
Extensive health care services, including dental and mental health
Insurance for travel and free-time
Lunch benefit
Phone subscription benefit
Weekly breakfasts and healthy daily refreshments
Flexible sports, culture, commuting and massage benefit
Recurring Roadie-ideated events and activities
Childcare services when your child falls ill
A possibility to book the office for private events during the weekends
Compensation for working on open source or social programs in your free time

We help companies sell better by building seamless digital solutions and running concrete growth activities. Find your Road with us by exploring open jobs or Connecting with us!
